description: This file is a script that processes other TypeScript source files to analyze channel boundary violations and related coding patterns in a project, utilizing the TypeScript compiler API for static analysis.

methods.name: findChannelAgnosticBoundaryViolations
methods.description: Analyzes source code content to detect violations of channel boundary rules, such as improper module imports, configuration path usage, channel comparisons, and property assignments related to channels.

methods.name: findChannelCoreReverseDependencyViolations
methods.description: Specifically detects violations related to channel core reverse dependencies, reusing the boundary violation logic with tailored options.

methods.name: findAcpUserFacingChannelNameViolations
methods.description: Checks for user-facing code that directly references channel names in a way that may violate accessibility or consistency guidelines.

methods.name: findSystemMarkLiteralViolations
methods.description: Detects hardcoded system mark literals in source code, which can be used for internal markers or debugging.

methods.name: main
methods.description: Main function that aggregates these analyses over the project files, reports violations, and enforces project boundaries.
